# Purpose
The provided content is a GitHub issue template designed for reporting bugs related to the Gson library. This template guides users in submitting detailed and structured bug reports by prompting them to provide specific information such as the Gson version, Java or Android version, and any relevant build tools or plugins used. It also includes sections for describing the bug, expected and actual behavior, reproduction steps, and any exception stack traces. By standardizing the information required, this template helps maintainers efficiently diagnose and address issues, ensuring that all necessary details are captured for effective troubleshooting.
